October 4 35.

Sir,

Further to my letter of September 7,
1935, I have the honour to inform you that Mr.
R. D. Tidy left Shanghai on October 2 for Hongkong
where he will visit a friend named Stone. Miss
Beck did not accompany him on this occasion.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

W. H. Childs, Esq.,
Commissioner of Police,
Sydney,
New South Wales.

Date October 3, 1935.

Subject Richard David Tidy.

Made by D.S. Poole. Forwarded by D.S.S. Boyne.

Richard David Tidy left Shanghai for Hongkong by
the N.Y.K. steamer "Tatsuta Maru" on October 2, 1935. He
was not accompanied by Miss Beck, but is meeting an old
Shanghai friend by the name of Stone in Hongkong.
Stone left Shanghai by the Blue Funnel Steamer
"Diaman" on September 10, 1935.

b.b.
D. S.

September 7 35.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. MA10781/2048 of November 17, 1933, and to inform
you that Miss Beck and Mr. Tidy returned to Shanghai
from Moscow on September 3, 1935.

An entry on Miss Beck's Alien Declaration
Form is to the effect that she intends proceeding
to Australia in the near future.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

W. H. Childs, Esq.,
Commissioner of Police,
Sydney,
New South Wales.

JR

REPORT .
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 5392 Date 5 / 9 35）
Date September 5. 19 35.
Subject Richard David Tidy and Dora Alice Beck (Absconded nurse from Isolation Hospital, Shanghai.). Further to information supplied.
Made by D. S. Poole. Forwarded by D.S.I. Boyne.

Miss Beck, who left Shanghai for Vladivostok on 30th August 1934 accompanied by R. D. Tidy, arrived back in Shanghai on 3rd September 1935 aboard the s.s. "Sever" of the State Transport Coy., a Soviet firm. She is not staying in Shanghai but will continue her journey to Sydney where her parents live.
The Chinese Passport Office was visited with regard to the particulars of these two persons and the following information was obtained:-
Richard David Tidy, aged 34, British subject (Australian)
Shanghai address: c/o Thomas Cook & Sons.
Home address: 37 Mill Hill Road, Sydney.
British passport No. 1391866, issued on 27th July 1933 in Sydney. Visaed for China at the Chinese Legation at Moscow during August 1935.
Friends in Shanghai: W. Powell, c/o China Weekly Review.
Doris Alice Beck, aged 28, British subject.
Home address: 18 Abbot Street, Coogee, Australia.
Profession: Nurse.
British passport No. A141374, issued 25th October 1933 in Sydney. Visaed for China at the Chinese Legation at Moscow during August 1935.
Friends in Shanghai: W. Powell, c/o China Weekly Review.
The office of Thomas Cook & Sons was visited in an endeavour to trace the Shanghai address of these persons, but were unable to give any information except that Tidy had yesterday called for two letters which had been addressed to their office and which had come from Moscow.
A further report will be submitted in due course.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Br.)
（签名：D. S. Poole）

（左侧批注：Their reason for visiting Russia is at present unknown. KG）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科第二股
报告 .
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科登记处 编号 S. B. D. 5392 日期 1935年9月5日）
日期 1935年9月5日。
事由 Richard David Tidy 和 Dora Alice Beck（从上海隔离医院潜逃的护士）。补充所提供的情报。
由警佐 D. S. Poole 制作。由副督察长 I. Boyne 转呈。

Beck 小姐曾于1934年8月30日由 R. D. Tidy 陪同离开上海前往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），她于1935年9月3日乘坐苏联国营运输公司（State Transport Coy.）的“Sever”号轮船返回上海。她不在上海停留，将继续前往其父母居住的悉尼。
就这两人的详细情况查询了中国护照办事处，获得如下信息：
Richard David Tidy，34岁，英国臣民（澳大利亚籍）
上海地址：转托马斯·库克父子公司（Thomas Cook & Sons）。
家庭住址：悉尼 Mill Hill Road 37号。
英国护照号码 1391866，1933年7月27日签发于悉尼。1935年8月在莫斯科的中国公使馆办理了中国签证。
在上海的朋友：W. Powell，转《密勒氏评论报》（China Weekly Review）。
Doris Alice Beck，28岁，英国臣民。
家庭住址：澳大利亚 Coogee，Abbot Street 18号。
职业：护士。
英国护照号码 A141374，1933年10月25日签发于悉尼。1935年8月在莫斯科的中国公使馆办理了中国签证。
在上海的朋友：W. Powell，转《密勒氏评论报》（China Weekly Review）。
为查找这两人在上海的地址，走访了托马斯·库克父子公司办公室，但除得知 Tidy 昨日来取了两封寄往该办公室、来自莫斯科的信件外，未能提供其他信息。
日后将提交进一步报告。
副总监（特别科）
（签名：D. S. Poole）

（左侧批注：他们访问俄国的原因目前尚不清楚。KG）

September 3 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. MAL0791/2048 of November 17, 1933 and to state
that Miss Doris Alice Beck resigned her post as
probationary Staff Nurse at the Municipal Isolation
Hospital on August 28 without giving any reason or
prior notice.

Enquiries made at local shipping offices
elicit the information that Miss Beck and R.D. Tidy
sailed for Vladivostock, U.S.S.R., on August 30 by
the San Peh Company's s.s. "Huashan". It is also
learned that Miss Beck and Mr. Tidy did not register
at H.B.M. Consulate-General, Shanghai, nor did they
make application there for marriage banns.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

W. H. Childs, Esq.,
Commissioner of Police,
Sydney,
New South Wales.

1934年9月3日。

先生：

谨此提及您1933年11月17日的第 MAL0791/2048 号来函，并陈述 Doris Alice Beck 小姐已于8月28日辞去其在市立隔离医院的试用职员护士职务，未说明任何理由，也未事先通知。

经向当地轮船公司查询，获悉 Beck 小姐和 R.D. Tidy 于8月30日乘坐三北轮船公司（San Peh Company）的“华山”号（Huashan）轮船前往苏联符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。另悉，Beck 小姐和 Tidy 先生并未在英国驻上海总领事馆登记，也未在该处申请结婚公告。

谨此致意，
先生，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S. 2, Special Branch Section,
REPORT
Date September 1. 1934.

Subject (in full) Richard David Tidy and Dora Alice Beck. Further to
information supplied.
Made by D.S. Poole Forwarded by [Signature] S.I.

Miss Beck left the Isolation Hospital on August 29,
1934, and left a note addressed to one of the sisters saying
that she was leaving and not returning (a copy of which is
attached). Dr. Smith (Superintendent of Hospitals) has been
interviewed and states that the Public Health Department wish
no police action taken as there is no financial indebtedness
on either side.

Enquiries at H.B.M. Consulate on the 30th August,
1934, show that Miss Beck and R.D. Tidy have not registered or
applied for marriage banns.

From enquiries at shipping offices it was learned
that both Miss Beck and R.D. Tidy sailed on a "San Peh"
Company's steamer "Huashan" on the 30th August 1934 bound
for Vladivostok.

[Signature]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 1934年9月1日。

事由（全称） Richard David Tidy 和 Dora Alice Beck。补充所提供的情报。
由警佐 D.S. Poole 制作，由 [签名] 督察长转呈。

Beck 小姐于1934年8月29日离开隔离医院，并给其中一位修女留下一张便条，称她将离开且不再返回（附副本一份）。已面询医院总监 Smith 医生，他表示公共卫生处不希望警方采取任何行动，因为双方均无财务债务纠纷。

1934年8月30日向英国总领事馆查询显示，Beck 小姐和 R.D. Tidy 既未登记，也未申请结婚公告。

经向轮船公司查询，获悉 Beck 小姐和 R.D. Tidy 均于1934年8月30日乘坐三北轮船公司（"San Peh" Company）的“华山”号（"Huashan"）轮船启程前往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。

[签名]
D. S.

特别科主管警官。

June 20 34.

W. H. Childs, Esq.,
Commissioner of Police,
Sydney,
New South Wales.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. MA10791/2048 of November 17, 1933, and to state
that the marriage of Doris Alice Beck and Richard
David Tidy has not yet taken place owing to the
inability of the latter to secure regular employment
in Shanghai, his present source of income being
limited to fees obtained from a few pupils to whom
he gives tuition in surveying work.

Miss Beck is at present a probationary
Staff Nurse at the Municipal Isolation Hospital,
41 Range Road, Shanghai, to which post she was
appointed on April 1, 1934.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Garforth
Commissioner of Police.

Date June 20, 1934）

Subject (in full) R.D. Tidy and Miss A.D. Beck. Enquiry re from
Commissioner of Police, Sydney.

Made by and Forwarded by D. S. I. Moore.

With reference to the attached request of the
Commissioner of Police, Sydney, to be advised of the marriage
in Shanghai of Richard David Tidy and Doris Alice Beck, I
have to report that the marriage has not yet taken place owing
to the inability of R.D. Tidy to find regular employment in
this city.

Miss Beck, who is a nurse by profession, is at present
a probationary Staff Nurse at the Municipal Isolation Hospital,
No. 41, Range Road, where she has been since April 1, 1934.

Tidy is living in a boarding house, No. 9 Park Lane,
where he is registered as an Engineer and Teacher. His
present source of remuneration is tutor in surveying to
occasional pupils.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

17th November, 1933.
(WHEN REPLYING, PLEASE QUOTE NO. NA10791/2048.

The Commissioner of Police,
International Settlement,
Municipal Council Chambers,
Shanghai,
CHINA.

Dear Sir,

I beg to acknowledge receipt of your cablegram
of the 7th instant, which reached me in the country, as
under:-

"Police, Sydney - Dick Tidy unknown here.
Police, Shanghai."

The facts of the matter are that the man referred
to, whose full name is Richard David Tidy, left here in
July last per the "Atsuto Maru" in company with a man named
Ernest George Ross, both having been licensed Surveyors in
this State. Since receipt of your cablegram I have seen the
young lady, Doris Alice Beck, who is proceeding to Shanghai
by the "Kamo Maru" leaving here on the 25th instant for the
purpose of being married on arrival. I have seen a letter
from Mr. Tidy who gives his address as c/o Thomas Cook and
Son, Nanking Road, Shanghai, and states in the letter that
he has a large class which he is coaching in his own
profession. He also states he is doing private work for
an Australian firm at 16 Central Arcade.

From what the young lady tells me I feel satisfied
the matter is genuine but I would ask that you might be good
enough to advise me of her marriage, etc., after her arrival.
Apart from her being an Australian girl the matter is of
further interest to me as her father and I were school mates.

Yours faithfully,

W. H. Childs,
Commissioner of Police.

尊敬的先生：

卑职谨此确认收到您本月7日的电报，该电报在我下乡期间送达，内容如下：

“悉尼警方 - 此处不知 Dick Tidy 其人。
上海警方。”

事实情况是，所述男子全名为 Richard David Tidy，于去年7月与一名名为 Ernest George Ross 的男子一同乘坐“敦贺丸”（Atsuto Maru）离开此地，两人均为本州的持证测量师。收到您的电报后，我会见了年轻女士 Doris Alice Beck，她将于本月25日乘坐“加茂丸”（Kamo Maru）离开此地前往上海，目的是抵达后结婚。我看到了一封 Tidy 先生的来信，他在信中给出的地址是上海南京路托马斯·库克父子公司转，并在信中表示他有一个大班的学生，正在亲自辅导其本专业课程。他还表示正在为一家位于中央商场（Central Arcade）16号的澳大利亚公司做私人工作。

根据这位年轻女士告诉我的一切，我确信此事属实，但恳请阁下在她抵达后，惠予告知其婚姻状况等事宜。除了她是一位澳大利亚姑娘外，此事令我格外关注的原因还在于她的父亲与我是同学。

此致，

W. H. Childs,
警务总监。
